project.title: Personal Job Tracker / Job Funnel
project.intent: Build a local Rails-based tracker that ingests already-deduped job/company source data, tracks jobs, applications, questions, resume data, interviews, artifacts, company research, and event history.
non_goals: No global cross-source deduplication in M0.
No login bypass or scraping behind authentication in M0.
No live auto-submit unless an apply adapter is explicitly implemented and tested against a safe target.
No external production deployment in M0. Localhost via Caddy only.

specs.title: Source and fetch run
specs.description: Source represents a provider of seed job/company data. It contains name, type, base_url, adapter, auth_mode, and enabled. FetchRun records adapter execution attempts for a source, including retry count, status, and JSON content containing evidence or captured errors.

acs.title: System can persist valid Source
acs.intent: Given valid Source attributes, a Source row is persisted in the selected DB engine.

acs.title: System can create FetchRun for enabled Source
acs.intent: Given an enabled Source, creating a fetch run persists a new FetchRun with status new and retry 0.

acs.title: System rejects invalid Source enums
acs.intent: Invalid source type, adapter, or auth_mode must not persist.

specs.title: Company
specs.description: Company stores organizations discovered from sources or manually added. It links to the source that introduced it and stores website and careers page URL.

acs.title: System can persist Company from Source
acs.intent: Given a valid source and company attributes, a Company row is persisted.

acs.title: Company URL fields are valid or blank
acs.intent: Website and careers page URL should either be blank or parse as URLs.

specs.title: Resume
specs.description: Resume stores structured JSON plus optional PDF location or blob reference. Resume is used when generating application drafts and submit payloads.

acs.title: System can persist structured Resume

acs.title: Resume JSON is required
acs.intent: A Resume cannot be created without structured JSON.

specs.title: Experience
specs.description: Experience stores a work-history entry extracted from a resume or entered manually.

acs.title: System can persist valid Experience
acs.intent: Given company name, title, description, and valid dates, an Experience row is persisted.

acs.title: Experience rejects impossible date range
acs.intent: End date cannot be earlier than start date.

specs.title: Resume experience link
specs.description: ResumeExperience connects Resume rows to parsed Experience rows.

acs.title: System can link Resume to Experience
acs.intent: Given existing Resume and Experience rows, the system persists a link row.

acs.title: System prevents duplicate ResumeExperience link
acs.intent: The same resume_id and experience_id pair should not be duplicated.

specs.title: Skill
specs.description: Skill stores normalized capability names and their type, such as programming_language, framework, library, technology, concern, or service.

acs.title: System can persist valid Skill
acs.intent: Given a skill name and valid type, a Skill row is persisted.

acs.title: System prevents duplicate normalized Skill
concerns: Rails vs Ruby on Rails aliases
acs.intent: The same normalized skill should not be created twice.

specs.title: Experience skill link
specs.description: ExperienceSkill connects Experience rows to Skill rows.

acs.title: System can link Experience to Skill
acs.intent: Given existing Experience and Skill rows, the system persists a link row.

acs.title: System prevents duplicate ExperienceSkill link
acs.intent: The same experience_id and skill_id pair should not be duplicated.

specs.title: Experience story
specs.description: ExperienceStory stores STAR-style examples linked to an Experience.

acs.title: System can persist ExperienceStory
acs.intent: Given an existing Experience and STAR fields, an ExperienceStory row is persisted.

acs.title: ExperienceStory requires action and result
acs.intent: Action and result should be present because they are needed for useful application answers.

specs.title: Question
specs.description: Question stores reusable applicant questions discovered during job research or manually added.

acs.title: System can persist valid Question
acs.intent: Given concern, text, and response_type, a Question row is persisted.

acs.title: Question text is required
acs.intent: A Question cannot be persisted without text.

specs.title: Question response
specs.description: QuestionResponse stores draft or approved answer material for a Question.

acs.title: System can persist draft QuestionResponse
acs.intent: Given a Question and response payload, a draft QuestionResponse is persisted.

acs.title: Approved response requires content
acs.intent: A response cannot transition to approved unless content is present.

acs.intent: Given valid source, company, canonical_id, title, and apply_url, a Job row is persisted with status new.

acs.intent: A Job cannot transition to skip without a skip_reason.

acs.title: canonical_id is unique per Source
acs.intent: The same source_id and canonical_id pair should not create duplicate jobs.

specs.title: Application

acs.title: System can create new Application

acs.title: Application status transition is valid
acs.intent: Application status transitions must follow the declared lifecycle.

acs.title: Only one active Application per Job
acs.intent: A job should not have multiple active application records in M0.

specs.title: Application question response link

acs.intent: Given existing Application and QuestionResponse rows, the system persists a link row.

acs.title: System prevents duplicate ApplicationQuestionResponse link
acs.intent: The same application_id and question_response_id pair should not be duplicated.

acs.title: Stage order is unique per Job
acs.intent: A job cannot have two interview stages with the same order.

specs.title: Interview
specs.description: Interview tracks a concrete interview instance for a job interview stage, including date, status, and result.

acs.title: System can persist Interview

acs.title: Completed Interview requires final result
acs.intent: When status is completed, result must be success or reject.

specs.title: Person

acs.title: Person contact fields are valid or blank

specs.title: Interview person link

acs.title: System can link Person to Interview

specs.title: Company employee link

specs.title: Company recruiter link
specs.description: CompanyRecruiter links people to companies as recruiter contacts.

acs.intent: Given existing Company and Person rows, the system persists a CompanyRecruiter link.

acs.title: System prevents duplicate CompanyRecruiter link
acs.intent: The same company_id and person_id pair should not be duplicated.

specs.title: Application artifact

acs.title: System can persist ApplicationArtifact
acs.intent: Given an Application and valid artifact type/content/status, the system persists an ApplicationArtifact row.

acs.title: Outreach message status transition is valid
acs.intent: Outreach messages must follow draft -> draft_accepted/draft_rejected -> processing -> message_sent -> waiting_response -> success/no_response.

specs.title: Company research
specs.description: CompanyResearch stores structured research tasks for a company, such as employees, problem statement, products, or blog.

acs.title: System can persist CompanyResearch
acs.intent: Given a Company and valid research type/status/content, the system persists a CompanyResearch row.

acs.title: CompanyResearch status transition is valid
acs.intent: Research status must follow draft -> in_progress -> review -> completed/rejected.

specs.title: Company insight
specs.description: CompanyInsight stores durable insights extracted from research, linked to a company.

acs.title: System can persist CompanyInsight
acs.intent: Given a Company and insight content, the system persists a CompanyInsight row.

acs.title: CompanyInsight content is required
acs.intent: An insight row cannot be persisted without content JSON.

specs.title: Event
specs.description: Event stores append-only evidence of system actions. Event type includes fetch, application, application_submit, job, and interview. Source is a string and payload is JSON.

acs.title: System can append Event
acs.intent: Given event type, source, payload, and timestamp, the system appends an Event row.

acs.title: Events are append-only
acs.intent: Existing events should not be updated or destroyed through normal application flows.

acs.title: Event timestamp is UTC ISO 8601
acs.intent: Event timestamps are stored in UTC and serialized as ISO 8601.

specs.title: Add new job/company source
specs.description: Add a new Source for fetching recent jobs or companies. M0 assumes source data is deduped enough and does not solve cross-source deduplication.

acs.title: System can create and store new valid Source
acs.intent: Given type, base_url, adapter, auth_mode, and enabled, the system creates exactly one Source row.

acs.title: Invalid Source is not persisted
acs.intent: If source attributes are invalid, no Source row is created.

specs.title: Create fetch run for source
specs.description: Create a FetchRun for an enabled Source and emit an Event of type fetch.

acs.title: System creates FetchRun for enabled Source
acs.intent: Given an enabled Source, system creates +1 FetchRun with status new and +1 Event type fetch.

acs.title: Disabled Source does not create FetchRun
acs.intent: Given a disabled Source, no FetchRun is created and an error event can be emitted.

specs.title: Run fetch run until completion
specs.description: Execute a FetchRun using its adapter and update state until completed or failed. Handles happy path, adapter_not_found, invalid_source, retry_exhausted, and server_error.

acs.title: Happy path imports jobs and companies
acs.intent: Given valid adapter output, system creates company/job rows, updates FetchRun on workflow steps, and emits a final fetch event.

acs.title: adapter_not_found fails FetchRun
acs.intent: If adapter cannot be resolved, FetchRun becomes failed and event.payload contains error message.

acs.title: invalid_source fails FetchRun
acs.intent: If source is invalid for adapter, FetchRun becomes failed and event.payload contains error message.

acs.title: retry_exhausted fails FetchRun
acs.intent: If retries exceed max 3, FetchRun becomes failed and event.payload includes retry evidence.

acs.title: server_error records failure evidence
acs.intent: Server errors are captured in FetchRun content and event payload.

specs.title: Add skills from seed JSON
specs.description: Import skills from known seed JSON into Skill rows.

acs.title: System creates Skill rows from seed
acs.intent: Given valid seed JSON, system creates +x Skill rows.

acs.title: Skill seed import is idempotent
acs.intent: Running the same seed twice does not create duplicate normalized skills.

specs.title: Add resume in JSON format
specs.description: Add structured resume JSON, extract known experience shape, persist resume, experiences, resume_experience links, and experience_skill links.

acs.title: System creates Resume and extracted experience graph
acs.intent: Given valid resume JSON, system creates +1 Resume, +x Experience, +x ResumeExperience, and +x ExperienceSkill rows.

acs.title: Invalid resume JSON rolls back
acs.intent: If resume JSON does not match the expected shape, no partial resume graph is persisted.

specs.title: Research job
specs.description: Research a Job to extract applicant questions and mentioned skills, then link them immediately to the Job. Emits job events when research starts and succeeds or fails.

acs.title: System extracts questions and skills from Job
acs.intent: Given a Job description/application page snapshot, system creates +x Question, +x JobQuestion, and +x JobSkill rows.

acs.title: Research emits start and finish events
acs.intent: Job research emits one event when started and one event when succeeded or failed.

specs.title: Start application for job
specs.description: Create an Application for a Job and Resume, draft question responses, link them immediately, and emit application events for creation, draft start, draft finish/failure, and ready-for-submit review.

acs.title: System creates Application and draft responses
acs.intent: Given Job, Resume, and linked JobQuestions, system creates +1 Application, +x draft QuestionResponse, and +x ApplicationQuestionResponse rows.

acs.title: Start application emits lifecycle events
acs.intent: System emits events for application record creation, draft start, draft success/failure, and ready-for-submit review.

specs.title: Submit application
specs.description: Transition Application to approved_for_submit, then use job.apply_adapter and job.apply_url with resume/question context. M0 should implement a safe stub adapter unless a real adapter is explicitly requested and reviewed.

acs.title: Approved Application can run apply adapter
acs.intent: Given an Application approved for submit, system runs apply adapter and emits application_submit start/finish/failure events.

acs.title: Unapproved Application cannot be submitted
acs.intent: Application must not run submit adapter before approved_for_submit.

acs.title: M0 submit adapter is safe stub
acs.intent: In M0, the default apply adapter records intended payload/evidence without submitting to external systems.

agent_prompt:
You are implementing M0 of the job-tracker project. Use this JSON as the source of truth. Build a local Rails app based on the Shore template reference if feasible, but prioritize satisfying the ACs over preserving template purity.

Goal: create a Rails 8.1 / Ruby 4.0.1 / PostgreSQL app with React + Inertia + vite_rails + Bun, Solid Queue/Cache/Cable, RSpec + FactoryBot, StandardRB/RuboCop, GitHub Actions, and Docker Compose behind an external Caddy proxy network.

Implementation rules:
1. Create Rails models/migrations for every model spec in this JSON. Use Rails enums or explicit validators for all declared enum fields. Use JSONB for content/payload/json fields. Use FK constraints and useful unique indexes where ACs mention duplicate prevention.
2. Implement the process services for adding sources, creating/running fetch runs, importing skills, adding resume JSON, researching jobs, starting applications, and submitting applications. For M0, submit application must use a safe stub adapter by default and must not send external applications.
3. Emit Event rows for every process AC that requires evidence. Events are append-only. Do not provide normal app flows that update or destroy events.
4. Add RSpec model specs and service specs for all automated ACs. Add FactoryBot factories for all models. Make tests readable and AC-traceable using comments or metadata like ac: 'AC-MODEL-10-01'.
5. Keep implementation boring. Prefer Rails conventions, service objects, transactions for multi-row writes, and explicit state transition methods. Do not add browser crawling, external ATS adapters, or live auto-apply in M0 unless needed by an AC here.
6. Add seed JSON import support for skills and a sample resume JSON fixture.
7. Add Docker Compose using project name job-tracker and Caddy labels for job-tracker.home.br11k.dev on external network proxy. Do not expose app ports directly to host unless strictly required for local debugging and documented as disabled by default.
8. Add README/AGENTS notes with commands to run: bin/setup, bin/rails db:prepare, bundle exec rspec, bundle exec standardrb, docker compose up.
9. Add CI that runs bundle install, DB setup, RSpec, linting, and security checks available in the template.
10. Before finishing, run tests/lint if possible, report exactly what passed/failed, list files changed, and map implemented ACs to tests.

First task: create a short implementation plan with migration/model/service/test order. Then implement in small commits or staged chunks. Do not silently skip ACs; mark any deferred AC with a clear reason.
